records.name: Child Care Scholarships (Child Care Services)
records.organization: Workforce Solutions for North Central Texas
records.description_en: Helps low-income families pay for child care so parents can work or go to school.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de bajos ingresos a pagar el cuidado de sus niños para que los padres puedan trabajar o estudiar.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income families. Parents must work, go to school, or be in training at least 25 hours a week on average (50 hours for two-parent families), or be looking for work. Income limits start at $5,216 a month (before taxes) for a family of 2.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos. Los padres deben trabajar, estudiar o estar en capacitación al menos 25 horas por semana en promedio (50 horas si son dos padres), o estar buscando trabajo. El límite de ingresos empieza en $5,216 al mes (antes de impuestos) para una familia de 2 personas.
documents_needed: Proof you live in the service area
Proof of U.S. citizenship or legal immigration status for each child
Pay stubs for the last 13 weeks for all working household members
Training or school information for household members who are enrolled
Proof of homelessness, if it applies to you
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Texas child care scholarship application. Call Child Care Services with questions.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en línea en la página de becas de cuidado infantil de Texas. Si tiene preguntas, llame a Servicios de Cuidado Infantil.
records.notes: Gross monthly income limits on source range from $5,216 (family of 2) to $11,045 (family of 10). Child Care Services phone and hours from dfwjobs.com/contactus (fax 940-387-0154). Board serves 14 counties: Collin, Denton, Ellis, Erath, Hood, Hunt, Johnson, Kaufman, Navarro, Palo Pinto, Parker, Rockwall, Somervell, Wise. A parent share of cost may apply under Texas rules but was not confirmed on the source page.

records.name: LifePath Systems Behavioral Health and Crisis Services
records.description_en: Mental health care, a 24/7 crisis line, early childhood intervention for babies and toddlers, and services for people with intellectual or developmental disabilities.
records.description_es: Atención de salud mental, una línea de crisis abierta las 24 horas, los 7 días, intervención temprana para bebés y niños pequeños, y servicios para personas con discapacidades intelectuales o del desarrollo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Collin County with mental health, intellectual, or developmental challenges. Anyone in crisis can call the crisis line.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas del condado de Collin con necesidades de salud mental, o con discapacidades intelectuales o del desarrollo. Cualquier persona en crisis puede llamar a la línea de crisis.
records.how_to_apply: In a crisis, call 1-877-422-5939 any time. For regular care, call Behavioral Health at (972) 422-5939.
records.how_to_apply_es: Si está en crisis, llame al 1-877-422-5939 a cualquier hora. Para atención regular, llame a Salud Conductual al (972) 422-5939.
records.notes: 24/7 Crisis Line: 1-877-422-5939. Behavioral health toll free: 1-844-544-5939. Early Childhood Intervention: (972) 562-0331. IDD: (972) 727-9133. Administration main line: (972) 562-0190. Address is the administration office; behavioral health listed for McKinney and Plano. Hours not listed on source. Collin County Local Mental Health Authority.

records.name: Denton County MHMR Center (My Health My Resources)
records.description_en: Mental health care, crisis help, and a psychiatric triage center for walk-in assessments. The crisis line is open 24/7.
records.description_es: Atención de salud mental, ayuda en crisis y un centro de evaluación psiquiátrica donde puede llegar sin cita. La línea de crisis está abierta las 24 horas, los 7 días.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Denton County. Anyone in a mental health crisis can call the crisis line.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas del condado de Denton. Cualquier persona en una crisis de salud mental puede llamar a la línea de crisis.
records.how_to_apply: In a crisis, call 1-800-762-0157 or 988. For services, call (940) 381-5000 for intake.
records.how_to_apply_es: Si está en crisis, llame al 1-800-762-0157 o al 988. Para recibir servicios, llame al (940) 381-5000.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8a-5p, Flexible Hours Available; crisis line 24/7
records.notes: Crisis hotline 1-800-762-0157 or 988 (24/7). Psychiatric Triage walk-in assessments: (940) 381-9965. Mailing: PO Box 2346, Denton, TX 76202. Substance use and disability services from the original record were not re-confirmed on the crisis services page.

records.name: Lakes Regional Community Center Crisis and Mental Health Services
records.description_en: Mental health and intellectual and developmental disability (IDD) services. People in Hunt, Kaufman, and Rockwall counties can call a 24/7 crisis line.
records.description_es: Servicios de salud mental y para personas con discapacidades intelectuales o del desarrollo. Las personas de los condados de Hunt, Kaufman y Rockwall pueden llamar a una línea de crisis abierta las 24 horas, los 7 días.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who live in the counties Lakes Regional serves, including Kaufman and Rockwall. Anyone in crisis can call.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en los condados que atiende Lakes Regional, incluyendo Kaufman y Rockwall. Cualquier persona en crisis puede llamar.
records.how_to_apply: In a crisis, call 866-260-8000 any time. For non-emergency help, call 877-505-2537. To start IDD services, call 903-243-9088.
records.how_to_apply_es: Si está en crisis, llame al 866-260-8000 a cualquier hora. Para ayuda que no es de emergencia, llame al 877-505-2537. Para empezar servicios de discapacidad intelectual o del desarrollo, llame al 903-243-9088.
records.notes: Lakes Regional lists crisis line 866-260-8000 for Hunt, Kaufman and Rockwall counties, marked as the NTBHA line (NTBHA is the local mental health authority for those counties). IDD intake: 903-243-9088. Local office addresses not listed on homepage.

records.name: Pecan Valley Centers - Cleburne Clinic
records.organization: Pecan Valley Centers for Behavioral & Developmental HealthCare
records.description_en: Mental health care at the Cleburne clinic. A 24/7 crisis hotline also does intake screening.
records.description_es: Atención de salud mental en la clínica de Cleburne. Una línea de crisis abierta las 24 horas, los 7 días, también hace la evaluación inicial para empezar servicios.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who live in Johnson County and nearby counties Pecan Valley serves.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en el condado de Johnson y otros condados cercanos que atiende Pecan Valley.
records.how_to_apply: Call the crisis and intake line at 1-800-772-5987, or call the Cleburne clinic.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis y evaluación inicial al 1-800-772-5987, o llame a la clínica de Cleburne.
records.hours: 8-5 PM; late hours 8-7 PM every Tuesday
records.notes: 24/7 Mental Health Crisis Hotline & Intake Screening: 1-800-772-5987. Pecan Valley serves Johnson, Somervell, Hood, Erath, Parker, and Palo Pinto counties.

records.name: North Texas Behavioral Health Authority (NTBHA)
records.description_en: Connects people to public mental health and substance use care, even if they cannot pay. Has care coordinators for Ellis County.
records.description_es: Le conecta con atención pública de salud mental y de uso de sustancias, aunque no pueda pagar. Tiene coordinadores de atención para el condado de Ellis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents of Dallas, Ellis, Hunt, Kaufman, Navarro, and Rockwall counties who need behavioral health care.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de los condados de Dallas, Ellis, Hunt, Kaufman, Navarro y Rockwall que necesitan atención de salud mental o de uso de sustancias.
records.how_to_apply: Call or text 214-366-9407, or call toll free 877-653-6363. Ellis County residents can call the South and East care coordinators at (469) 780-9159.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un mensaje de texto al 214-366-9407, o llame gratis al 877-653-6363. Los residentes del condado de Ellis pueden llamar a los coordinadores de atención al (469) 780-9159.
records.notes: Crisis lines (24/7): (866) 260-8000 or (844) 672-5700. Toll free: 877-653-6363. Ellis County care coordinators email: SouthandEastCareCoordinators@ntbha.org. General email info@ntbha.org. Physical address not listed on source. Serves care regardless of ability to pay per source.

records.name: Collin County Indigent Health Program
records.description_en: Helps pay for health care for low-income adults in Collin County who qualify.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar la atención médica de adultos de bajos ingresos en el condado de Collin que califican.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For adult Collin County residents with low income and few resources, based on federal poverty guidelines. You must show proof of income and resources.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para adultos que viven en el condado de Collin con ingresos bajos y pocos recursos, según las guías federales de pobreza. Debe mostrar prueba de sus ingresos y recursos.
documents_needed: Other supporting documents listed on the application
records.how_to_apply: Apply online, by mail, or drop off the form in person. A decision is made within 14 business days after a complete application.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en línea, por correo o en persona. Le darán una respuesta en un plazo de 14 días hábiles después de entregar la solicitud completa.
records.hours: Monday - Thursday 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM (Closed Friday - Sunday)
records.notes: Source says program is for 'qualified, adult indigent residents'; min_age 18 inferred from 'adult'. Exact income limit not stated on page.

records.name: Collin County WIC Program
records.description_en: Healthy food benefits, nutrition classes, and breastfeeding help for pregnant women, new moms, and kids under 5.
records.description_es: Beneficios para comprar comida saludable, clases de nutrición y ayuda con la lactancia para mujeres embarazadas, mamás nuevas y niños menores de 5 años.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant women, women breastfeeding a baby under 1, women who had a baby in the last 6 months, and children under 5. Income must be at or below 185% of the poverty level, or you get Medicaid, SNAP, or TANF.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres embarazadas, mujeres que dan pecho a un bebé menor de 1 año, mujeres que tuvieron un bebé en los últimos 6 meses y niños menores de 5 años. Sus ingresos deben estar al 185% del nivel de pobreza o menos, o debe recibir Medicaid, SNAP o TANF.
documents_needed: Proof of income for all household members
records.how_to_apply: Request a first appointment at texaswic.org, call your nearest office, or text 85511.
records.how_to_apply_es: Pida su primera cita en texaswic.org, llame a la oficina más cercana o mande un mensaje de texto al 85511.
records.hours: Mon & Wed 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; Tue & Thu 8 a.m.-5:30 p.m.; Fri 8 a.m.-1 p.m. (appointments required)
records.notes: Second clinic: 900 E. Park Blvd., Plano, TX 75074, (972) 633-3350, same hours. Emails: mckinneywic@co.collin.tx.us, planowic@co.collin.tx.us.

records.name: Collin County Immunizations Clinic
records.description_en: Vaccines for eligible children and adults.
records.description_es: Vacunas para niños y adultos que califican.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For eligible children and adults. Call to check if you qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para niños y adultos que califican. Llame para saber si usted califica.
records.how_to_apply: Call to make an appointment. The clinic is by appointment only.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer una cita. La clínica atiende solo con cita.
records.cost: Fees follow the county clinic fee schedule; call for cost
records.notes: Uninsured people can call to schedule MMR shots. Same building also has TB clinic (Mon-Fri 8:30 a.m.-5 p.m., 972-548-5500) and STD/HIV clinic (972-548-5500).

records.name: Denton County Public Health Clinical Services
records.description_en: Primary care, dental care, shots, women's health, STI testing, and TB services at two county clinics.
records.description_es: Atención médica primaria, atención dental, vacunas, salud de la mujer, pruebas de infecciones de transmisión sexual y servicios de tuberculosis en dos clínicas del condado.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For most services, eligibility is based on income, resources, where you live, and who is in your household.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para la mayoría de los servicios, se decide si califica según sus ingresos, sus recursos, dónde vive y quién vive en su hogar.
records.how_to_apply: Call to schedule an eligibility screening appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer una cita de evaluación para ver si califica.
records.hours: Monday through Friday 7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. (appointments required)
records.cost: Based on eligibility; call for details
records.notes: Lewisville clinic: 190 N Valley Parkway, Lewisville, TX 75067, (972) 434-4700, same hours. Source says appointments are required.

records.name: Denton County WIC
records.description_en: Healthy food benefits and nutrition help for pregnant women, new moms, and young children.
records.description_es: Beneficios para comprar comida saludable y ayuda con la nutrición para mujeres embarazadas, mamás nuevas y niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant women, new mothers, and young children who meet Texas WIC income rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres embarazadas, mamás nuevas y niños pequeños que cumplen con las reglas de ingresos de WIC de Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Apply at texaswic.org or call any Denton County WIC clinic.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en texaswic.org o llame a cualquier clínica de WIC del condado de Denton.
records.notes: Other clinics (same phone and hours): 190 N Valley Parkway, Lewisville 75067; 3024 E Hebron Pkwy, Carrollton 75010.

records.name: Kaufman County Indigent Health Care Program
records.description_en: Helps pay for needed medical care for very low-income Kaufman County residents.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar atención médica necesaria para residentes del condado de Kaufman con ingresos muy bajos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Kaufman County residents with monthly net income at or below 21% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines and resources under $2,000 ($3,000 if an aged or disabled relative lives in the household). You must have a medical need.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Kaufman con ingresos netos mensuales al 21% de las guías federales de pobreza o menos, y recursos de menos de $2,000 ($3,000 si en el hogar vive un familiar mayor o con discapacidad). Debe tener una necesidad médica.
records.how_to_apply: Download the English or Spanish application from the county website, or call or visit the office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue la solicitud en inglés o en español del sitio web del condado, o llame o visite la oficina. Hay personal que habla español.
records.notes: Email: indigenthealth@kaufmancounty.net. Fax 469-595-0496. Program coordinator speaks Spanish.

records.name: CommonGood Medical (formerly Hope Clinic of McKinney)
records.description_en: A faith-based clinic that gives medical care and support to uninsured adults in Collin County.
records.description_es: Una clínica basada en la fe que da atención médica y apoyo a adultos sin seguro médico en el condado de Collin.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Collin County residents with no insurance (no Medicaid, Medicare, or other coverage) who meet household income rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Collin sin seguro médico (sin Medicaid, Medicare u otra cobertura) que cumplen con las reglas de ingresos del hogar.
records.how_to_apply: Call the McKinney clinic to ask about becoming a patient.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica de McKinney para preguntar cómo hacerse paciente.
records.hours: Weekdays 8:30 AM - 5 PM (closed noon-1 PM); 10 AM - 3 PM third Saturday
records.notes: hopeclinicmckinney.org redirects to commongoodmedical.org. Farmersville clinic Fridays 8:30 AM-4 PM (closed noon-1 PM) at 206 N. Main St. (First United Methodist Church), Farmersville 75442. Email Info@CommonGoodMedical.org. Exact income limit not confirmed.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - McKinney Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people, such as family law, housing, and benefits problems.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis en casos civiles para personas de bajos ingresos, como problemas de familia, vivienda y beneficios.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents with a civil (not criminal) case. You likely qualify if you get SNAP, Medicaid, SSI, WIC, or live in public housing. Some immigrant survivors of crime or abuse may also qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para ciudadanos de EE. UU. y residentes permanentes legales de bajos ingresos con un caso civil (no criminal). Es probable que califique si recibe SNAP, Medicaid, SSI o WIC, o si vive en vivienda pública. Algunas personas inmigrantes que sobrevivieron un crimen o abuso también pueden calificar.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Legal Aid Line at 1-888-529-5277, apply online, or visit the office. Call the local office if you have a court deadline or were served with a lawsuit.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la Línea de Ayuda Legal al 1-888-529-5277, presente su solicitud en línea o visite la oficina. Si tiene una fecha límite en la corte o le entregaron una demanda, llame a la oficina local.
records.notes: Toll-free: 866-511-8018. Legal Aid Line 888-529-5277 (8 a.m.-5 p.m. Mon-Fri). Exceptions for immigrant survivors (U/T visa, VAWA). Office hours not listed.

records.notes: Toll-free: 866-614-3344. Office hours not listed.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas Landlord-Tenant Line
records.description_en: Free legal help line for renters with landlord problems, like eviction or repairs.
records.description_es: Línea de ayuda legal gratis para inquilinos con problemas con el dueño, como desalojos o reparaciones.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income renters in counties served by Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para inquilinos de bajos ingresos en los condados que atiende Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Call the landlord-tenant line at 855-548-8457.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea para inquilinos al 855-548-8457.
records.notes: LANWT serves counties in North and West Texas; only Collin, Denton and Ellis are confirmed here via local offices. Johnson, Kaufman and Rockwall residents should call 1-888-529-5277 (8 a.m.-5 p.m. Mon-Fri) to confirm. Hours not listed for the landlord-tenant line.

records.name: The Samaritan Inn Housing Program
records.description_en: Shelter and a housing program for people who are homeless, with case management, free counseling, job help, and money classes.
records.description_es: Albergue y programa de vivienda para personas sin hogar, con manejo de casos, consejería gratis, ayuda para encontrar trabajo y clases sobre el manejo del dinero.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For homeless men, women, and families with children. You must be drug and alcohol free for 30 days (there is a drug test), usually have no violent offenses, and be willing to work full-time (part-time if disabled).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hombres, mujeres y familias con niños que no tienen hogar. Debe estar libre de drogas y alcohol por 30 días (hay una prueba de drogas), normalmente no tener delitos violentos y estar dispuesto a trabajar tiempo completo (medio tiempo si tiene una discapacidad).
documents_needed: Social Security card (or number if you do not have the card)
records.how_to_apply: Come to an intake interview on Tuesdays, Thursdays, or Sundays from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM. First come, first served.
records.how_to_apply_es: Venga a una entrevista de admisión los martes, jueves o domingos de 8:00 AM a 1:00 PM. Se atiende por orden de llegada.
records.hours: Intake: Tuesdays, Thursdays & Sundays 8:00 AM - 1:00 PM
records.notes: Violent offenses over 10 years old may be considered. Life skills classes (money and job readiness) are required. Email info@saminn.org. Collin County service area inferred from McKinney location.

records.name: Minnie's Food Pantry
records.description_en: Free groceries by drive-thru, plus walk-up help for people who are homeless and a free clothing boutique.
records.description_es: Comida gratis por servicio desde el carro, ayuda para personas sin hogar que llegan a pie y una tienda gratis de ropa.
records.eligibility_summary_en: No one is turned away at the drive-thru. Bring a photo ID and a utility bill. The boutique needs an intake appointment and proof of low income.
records.eligibility_summary_es: No se rechaza a nadie en el servicio desde el carro. Traiga una identificación con foto y un recibo de servicios (luz, agua o gas). Para la tienda de ropa necesita una cita de admisión y prueba de bajos ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Drive through during open hours and stay in your car; households may come once a month. Walk-up guests experiencing homelessness may come weekly.
records.how_to_apply_es: Pase en su carro en el horario de servicio y quédese dentro del carro; cada hogar puede venir una vez al mes. Las personas sin hogar que llegan a pie pueden venir cada semana.
records.notes: Boutique (free clothing and household items) at 651 18th Street, same hours.

records.name: Frisco Family Services
records.description_en: Emergency money help, a food market, seasonal help like back-to-school and holiday programs, and life skills classes.
records.description_es: Ayuda de emergencia con dinero, un mercado de comida, ayuda de temporada como útiles escolares y programas de días festivos, y clases de habilidades para la vida.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the Frisco and Frisco ISD community. Call to check if you qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de la comunidad de Frisco y del distrito escolar de Frisco (Frisco ISD). Llame para saber si califica.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the main office during business hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina principal en horario de oficina.
records.hours: Office & Food Market: M-F, 9 AM-5 PM
records.notes: Food Market at 9085 Dogwood St. Frisco spans Collin and Denton counties. Formal residency rules not stated on homepage.

records.name: All Community Outreach (ACO)
records.description_en: Food and essentials, help with rent and utility bills, and career and education programs.
records.description_es: Comida y artículos básicos, ayuda para pagar la renta y los servicios (luz, agua, gas), y programas de carrera y educación.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Serves Collin County neighbors in need. Call to check eligibility.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Atiende a vecinos del condado de Collin que necesitan ayuda. Llame para saber si califica.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit during open hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite en el horario de atención.
records.hours: Mon, Wed-Fri 9:00 AM-4:00 PM; Tue 9:00 AM-6:00 PM
records.notes: Specific eligibility rules not listed on homepage.

records.name: Christian Community Action (CCA)
records.description_en: A food market, job and education programs, kids' programs like Kids Eat Free, senior services, and counseling.
records.description_es: Un mercado de comida, programas de trabajo y educación, programas para niños como Kids Eat Free, servicios para personas mayores y consejería.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Serves low-income residents of Denton County. Call to check eligibility.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Atiende a residentes de bajos ingresos del condado de Denton. Llame para saber si califica.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Lewisville office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina de Lewisville.
records.notes: Hours not listed on homepage. Faith-based organization. Seeds for Success program accepts applications based on capacity.

records.name: Interfaith Ministries of Denton Emergency Assistance
records.description_en: Short-term emergency help with utility bills, diapers (for babies and adults), hygiene items, and DCTA bus passes.
records.description_es: Ayuda de emergencia a corto plazo con recibos de servicios (luz, agua, gas), pañales (para bebés y adultos), artículos de higiene y pases de autobús de DCTA.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who live in the service area with income at or below 80% of the DFW area median income who have a sudden, documented crisis they did not cause.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en el área de servicio, con ingresos al 80% del ingreso medio del área de DFW o menos, y que tienen una crisis repentina y comprobada que no causaron.
records.how_to_apply: Send an information request through their website contact form, or call. This first step is not the application.
records.how_to_apply_es: Mande una solicitud de información por el formulario de contacto de su sitio web, o llame. Este primer paso no es la solicitud.
records.hours: Mon-Thu 9:00 AM-4:00 PM (closed 1-2 PM); Fri 9:00 AM-1:00 PM (appointments 2-4 PM)
records.notes: No rental assistance program. Email info@ifmdenton.org.

records.name: Denton County Friends of the Family
records.organization: Denton County Friends of the Family
records.description_en: Emergency shelter, transitional housing, counseling, legal advocacy, and crisis help for people hurt by domestic violence, rape, or sexual abuse.
records.description_es: Albergue de emergencia, vivienda de transición, consejería, apoyo legal y ayuda en crisis para personas afectadas por violencia doméstica, violación o abuso sexual.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For survivors of domestic violence, rape, and sexual abuse and their children in Denton County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica, violación y abuso sexual, y sus hijos, en el condado de Denton.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24-hour crisis hotline at 940-382-7273.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis de 24 horas al 940-382-7273.
records.notes: Phone listed is the 24-hour crisis hotline.

records.name: DCTA Reduced Fare Program
records.description_en: Lower bus and train fares for seniors, people with disabilities, Medicare cardholders, and students.
records.description_es: Tarifas más bajas de autobús y tren para personas mayores, personas con discapacidades, personas con tarjeta de Medicare y estudiantes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people 65 or older, people with disabilities, Medicare cardholders, and students 6-18 with a student ID. Children under 5 ride free.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de 65 años o más, personas con discapacidades, personas con tarjeta de Medicare y estudiantes de 6 a 18 años con identificación escolar. Los niños menores de 5 años viajan gratis.
documents_needed: Proof of eligibility (age, disability, Medicare card, or student ID)
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the DCTA Reduced Fare application (English, Spanish, or Hakha Chin) to get a Reduced Fare Eligible badge. Call with questions.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud de tarifa reducida de DCTA (en inglés, español o hakha chin) para recibir una credencial de tarifa reducida. Llame si tiene preguntas.
records.notes: The badge is not a pass; riders still pay the reduced fare. DCTA also has a Non-Profit Pass Program. No general low-income fare confirmed on the reduced fare page.
